# Nob End Run Club

> A friendly social running club based at Nob End Nature Reserve, Little Lever, Bolton, Greater Manchester, UK. All abilities, ages and people welcome, beginners included. Website: https://nobendrunclub.uk

## Weekly schedule
- Wednesday track night: Leverhulme Park athletics track, Bolton. Meet 7:50pm, run starts 8pm, about an hour.
- Wednesday pub run (non-track weeks): around 7:30pm. Road run around Bolton, trails in lighter months. Start point changes weekly and usually finishes at a pub.
- Sunday: 9am unless stated otherwise. Road, trail or canal run around Nob End, Little Lever and the Irwell Valley, followed by coffee and cake.
- Weekly start points are posted on Facebook, Instagram and the club WhatsApp group.

## Location and areas
- Base: Nob End Nature Reserve, Little Lever, Bolton. Track: Leverhulme Park, Bolton.
- Nearby areas: Bolton, Little Lever, Farnworth, Kearsley, Radcliffe, Prestolee, Breightmet, Bury. Easy to reach from Salford and Manchester (Leverhulme Park is roughly 30 minutes by car from Manchester city centre).

## Run leader
- Jimmy Hark: personal trainer and gym co-founder. Received the Bolton Civic Medal in December 2025.
